items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Fortunately because it was very demanding at that tempo and Miles was in trouble so I had that in mind as a leader.

ctx.x: I’ve forgotten his name . . . but he showed me that material before the date and I tried to learn it. Fortunately because it was very demanding at that tempo and Miles was in trouble so I had that in mind as a leader. I was pleased that it turned out as well as it did. But that ballad was quite exceptional too.
“Odjenar”. That’s pretty challenging too, with those intervals. It’s a slower tempo but those intervals are tough.
